rows: None: clim's desk reads Fables' live ETH/USDG pool and publishes its own recommendation next to the keeper's overrides
The CRE workflow's `rh-shadow-settings` target reads the mainnet pool (read only, never a write); see [`cre/README.md`](../../cre/README.md)
A few lines in the off-chain keeper: read `ClimFeePolicy` over RPC and compose with the keeper's own fee
Works today against the testnet desk: [`keeper-read.ts`](keeper-read.ts)
One AccessManager batch, revocable in one call
Bounded by the hook's own floor, cap and TTL; only roles Fables grants can call `ClimPoker`; clim holds no admin power; a silent desk means no poke
Batch encoded from the ABIs and executed against Fables' real AccessManager on a mainnet fork; live on clim's own testnet pools
the keeper (FEE_POKER) posts its event overrides through ClimPoker
CLIM_RUNNER may trigger a poke (the fee still comes from the policy)
clim's runner bot pokes after each desk report
ADMIN (the default admin of a new role)

params.note: Fables' AccessManager on Robinhood Chain mainnet. The poker address is the ClimPoker of the recorded fork run (docs/evidence/fork-run-2026-10-07.json), deployed only on a fork; the runner is the fork suite's runner (makeAddr("climRunner")); the second CLIM_RUNNER account is Fables' keeper 0x1B6a...d429 (FEE_POKER at fork block 87,780,000). A mainnet batch uses the address ClimPoker gets when deployed and clim's runner key.

batchFork.requiredCaller: an account holding ADMIN (role 0) and POKER_ADMIN (role 5) with no execution delay, or send the grantRole(FEE_POKER) call from a POKER_ADMIN holder and the rest from an ADMIN holder

calls.description: FEE_POKER to ClimPoker: it may call the hook's pokeFee (needs POKER_ADMIN, role 5)
postEvent and postEventAndPoke on ClimPoker for FEE_POKER: the keeper posts its event overrides there (needs ADMIN, role 0)
poke on ClimPoker for CLIM_RUNNER (needs ADMIN)
CLIM_RUNNER to clim's runner 0x9071328d72b35420DcF7938d1F64Ab44Deb9D607 (needs ADMIN, the default admin of a new role)
CLIM_RUNNER to account 1 0x1B6a8808E1D26dba66bA11E52997803C43CAd429 (needs ADMIN, the default admin of a new role)

stop.description: revoke FEE_POKER from ClimPoker: every poke reverts in the hook from the next block (needs POKER_ADMIN)
